cache_regime: CAMI verdict cache disabled; per-run in-memory AST cache normal; Docker image preinstalled, host filesystem/Docker caches not cleared. A separate profiling baseline precedes measured runs.
claim_to_evaluate: For these two authored histories on this host, report elapsed CLI-run time and maintenance time for each fixed policy/provenance variant, with work and availability outcomes. Do not infer production or real-data speedup.
clock: time.perf_counter around fresh subprocess python -m cami.cli run, including startup/preflight/persistence; fixture preparation, verification and scoring excluded
comparisons: Within each history, each nonbaseline variant versus all_validate. Report all five paired deltas, median, range and counts. Timing repeats are not independent datasets. No population confidence interval. Hidden-missing cost must be shown alongside known availability errors.
expected_checks: verify_run validates manifest hashes, complete state/selection/validation coverage, parent support, selected-step expectations, cache disabled and execution counts. Audit every raw probe result as passed or assertion_failure and compare totals.
failure_policy: Stop on any CLI failure, missing execution, changed input/source, wrong expected outcome or technical probe failure; preserve partial results; do not silently retry or exclude runs.
limits: Two constructed histories with one claim each; not a production workload or real cohort.
Validation includes three repeats; counts do not represent independent claims.
Profile distinguishes Docker subprocess waiting from host work, not container-startup from child pytest internals.
Configs are protocol-fixed, not tuned alternatives; no recommendation about adopting a policy from timings alone.
order: Variant order rotates cyclically by repeat; history block order alternates. Deterministic balanced-position first four repeats plus one extra repeat.

profile.tool: cProfile: host call path; Docker child CPU is not profiled

resource_policy: No simultaneous CAMI test/benchmark jobs; record load and running Docker containers. Do not stop unrelated processes. Existing runner resource limits, retries and pinned images retained.
